new_candidates.body:
### Summary

Follow-up to #3457. Checked against `mujoco` 3.15.0 and `main`. `MjcPhysicsSceneAPI` can't represent these MJCF settings:

| MJCF | Since | `mjcPhysics` USD schema |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<option integrator="discrete">` | 3.13 | `mjc:option:integrator` `allowedTokens` lacks `"discrete"` |
| `<option><flag ipc="enable"/></option>` | 3.14 | no `mjc:flag:ipc` |
| `<option><flag diagexact="enable"/></option>` | 3.9 | no `mjc:flag:diagexact` |

### Why it matters

The USD decoder silently falls back to `euler` for unrecognized integrator tokens, so a model using the `discrete` integrator loses it on a USD round trip, and with it the `ipc` contact mode. MJCF-to-USD converters have no schema-defined place to record these settings.

### Request

Add `"discrete"` to the `mjc:option:integrator` tokens, add `mjc:flag:ipc` and `mjc:flag:diagexact` to `MjcPhysicsSceneAPI`, and parse them in the USD decoder.

### Reproduction

```python
import mujoco

for xml in [
    '<mujoco><option integrator="discrete"/></mujoco>',
    '<mujoco><option integrator="discrete" solver="CG"><flag ipc="enable"/></option></mujoco>',
    '<mujoco><option><flag diagexact="enable"/></option></mujoco>',
]:
    mujoco.MjSpec.from_string(xml).compile()  # all compile
```

```bash
schema="$(python -c 'import mujoco,os;print(os.path.dirname(mujoco.__file__))')/include/mujoco/experimental/usd/mjcPhysics"
grep -n -A1 'Allowed Values" | euler' "$schema/sceneAPI.h"  # euler, rk4, implicit, implicitfast
grep -rni 'ipc\|diagexact' "$schema"  # (no output)
```
new_candidates.title: mjcPhysics USD schema missing discrete integrator, ipc and diagexact flags

new_candidates.body:
With `-DMUJOCO_WITH_USD=ON` on current `main` (`12720007e`), the USD tests can't be built or run from a plain build tree. There are two separate problems.

**Setup:** Ubuntu 22.04 on x86_64, GCC 11.4, CMake 4.4 (Unix Makefiles), OpenUSD 25.11.

### 1. `usd_decoder_test` uses internal include paths

```
test/plugin/usd_decoder/usd_decoder_test.cc:25:10: fatal error: third_party/usd/v26/pxr/base/arch/fileSystem.h: No such file or directory
```

`test/plugin/usd_decoder/usd_decoder_test.cc` includes nine OpenUSD headers as `"third_party/usd/v26/pxr/..."`. Every other OpenUSD include in the repository (468 of them) uses `<pxr/...>`. A full `cmake --build build` fails the same way.

These lines came in with the Copybara merge of #3635 (`b70ab9c9c`). That PR's own commits used `<pxr/...>`, so the paths appear to be rewritten on import and not mapped back on export for this file. `80c1cc346` added the equivalent transform for `newton_tokens.h` in `plugin/usd_decoder/`, but nothing covers `test/plugin/usd_decoder/`. #3636 also edits this test file, so it may hit the same rewrite. The GitHub workflows configure with `-DMUJOCO_WITH_USD=OFF`, so CI can't catch either problem.

### 2. `mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda` is staged only by `cmake --install`

When `libmujoco` loads, it registers USD plugins from the `mujoco-usd-resources` directory next to it (`src/experimental/usd/utils.cc`). The test binaries load `build/lib/libmujoco.so`, so CTest always uses `build/lib/mujoco-usd-resources`, whether or not the build has been installed.

The build tree is set up for this. `plugInfo.json` for `usdMjcf`, `mjcPhysics` and `newton` is generated there, with library paths relative to the build tree, and `install_newton_usd_plugin` copies the Newton `generatedSchema.usda` there at configure time. The `mjcPhysics` schema, however, is listed only in `install(FILES mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda ...)`, so the build tree gets its `plugInfo.json` without the schema:

```
Warning: in _GetGeneratedSchema at line 804 of pxr/usd/usd/schemaRegistry.cpp -- Failed to open schema layer at path '<build>/lib/mujoco-usd-resources/mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda'. Any schemas defined in plugin library 'mjcPhysics' will not have valid prim definitions.
```

The `mjc:` schema definitions are then missing, and the tests fail on wrong values rather than crashing. 84 of the 164 USD tests fail: 77 in `usd_decoder_test` and 7 in `MjcfSdfFileFormatPluginTest`. For example:

```
mju_user_error: Invalid size for o_solref attribute: 0 expected 2
C++ exception with description "Used null prim" thrown in the test body.
```

Copying the schema into the build tree as well, the way the Newton plugin already does, would fix this:

```cmake
configure_file(
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda"
  "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${MJ_USD_INSTALL_DIR_LIB}/mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda"
  COPYONLY)
```

### Reproduction

```sh
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DMUJOCO_WITH_USD=ON -DMUJOCO_BUILD_TESTS=ON -Dpxr_DIR=<OpenUSD build or install>
cmake --build build --target usd_decoder_test mjcf_file_format_test usdMjcf
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Usd|MjcfSdfFileFormatPluginTest'
```

The build fails with problem 1. After changing the nine includes to `<pxr/...>`, it builds, and CTest shows problem 2. After also copying `src/experimental/usd/mjcPhysics/generatedSchema.usda` into `build/lib/mujoco-usd-resources/mjcPhysics/`, all 164 tests pass.
new_candidates.title: MUJOCO_WITH_USD=ON: usd_decoder_test fails to compile, and USD tests fail from the build tree
